records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shuttle/README.md
records.summary: Shuttle records signed agent workflow transitions in append-only records and exports their evidence to Quipu.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/shuttle/shuttle%2Fcli.py
records.summary: The CLI defines and advances workflows, exports history, verifies signatures and freezes windows. It has no HTTP or MCP server.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/shuttle/shuttle%2Fstate.py
records.summary: SHUTTLE_STATE_DIR selects local append-only workflow state; otherwise the user state directory is used.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/shuttle/shuttle%2Fsigning.py
records.summary: SHUTTLE_KEY_DIR selects agent key storage; require-existing-key mode refuses missing or unsafe key files and does not create replacements.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/shuttle/shuttle%2Fmodel.py
records.summary: Workflow definitions and transition events are pure data models; replay folds validated transitions to reconstruct state.

properties.publicName: Workflow definition JSON and transition records

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/shuttle/shuttle%2Fquipu_client.py
records.summary: The client uses Quipu HTTP graph, knot and episode APIs. Capability and write refusals are distinct from empty results; it does not serve REST itself.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/shuttle/shuttle%2Fseeds.py
records.summary: Seed steps create and reconcile linked work through the configured sd executable; backend routing belongs to that client.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shuttle/docs%2Fdesign%2Fshuttle.md
records.summary: The v1 design deliberately exposes a CLI and library rather than a daemon, HTTP or MCP server. Consumers read the governed graph instead.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shuttle/README.md
records.summary: Begin with the workflow quick start and role in the stack; registration and production writes remain explicit operator actions.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shuttle/docs%2Foperating.md
records.summary: Read the operational command and environment contract before exporting or freezing workflow history.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/shuttle/docs%2Fseed-steps.md
records.summary: Read seed-step visit, replay and outcome semantics before connecting work-item completion to workflow transitions.
